definitions.explanation: A point where segments connect, such as bamboo joints or finger joints.
A musical melody or the way something is sung.
A particular instance or aspect of something.

examples.japanese: {竹|たけ}の{節|ふし}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see the joints of the bamboo.

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}の{節|ふし}が{太|ふと}い。
この{板|いた}は{節|ふし}が{多|おお}くて{使|つか}いにくい。
examples.english: This board has many knots and is hard to use.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}ながらの{節|ふし}で{歌|うた}う。
examples.english: To sing in an old-fashioned melody.

examples.japanese: {独特|どくとく}の{節|ふし}をつけて{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: He read it aloud with a distinctive melody.
examples.notes: {節|ふし}をつける = to set to a tune, to add a melody

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}がよく{口|くち}ずさんでいた{節|ふし}を{今|いま}でも{覚|おぼ}えている。
examples.english: I still remember the tune my grandmother used to hum.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}には{不審|ふしん}な{節|ふし}がある。
examples.english: There are suspicious aspects to his story.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{当|あ}たる{節|ふし}がある。
examples.notes: {思|おも}い{当|あ}たる{節|ふし} = something one can think of, a point that rings a bell

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}が{変|か}わったと{感|かん}じる{節|ふし}がいくつかあった。
examples.english: There were several points at which I felt his attitude had changed recently.

notes:
Multiple meanings centered around points of connection or division.

MEANING 1 - JOINTS/KNOTS:
・{竹|たけ}の{節|ふし} (bamboo joint)
・{指|ゆび}の{節|ふし} (finger joint/knuckle)
・{木|き}の{節|ふし} (knot in wood)

MEANING 2 - MELODY:
・{節|ふし}をつける (to set to a tune)
・{節回|ふしまわ}し (way of singing, melody style)

MEANING 3 - POINT/ASPECT:
・〜{節|ふし}がある (there is an aspect of ~)
・{不審|ふしん}な{節|ふし} (suspicious points)

HOMOPHONE (different reading):
・{節|せつ} - section, clause; season
